newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian minister expects IMF to pay loan tranche.
newsitem.headline: Russian minister expects IMF to pay loan tranche.

text.p: Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin said on Wednesday he expected the International Monetary Fund to hand over another tranche of a three-year $10 billion loan to Russia, although it was hard to say when the money would come.

"I believe that everything will work out with the IMF in the end and they will give the tranche, but is very difficult to say because they do not have much time before the end of the month," Yasin told a news conference.
The IMF withheld two tranches of the loan last year because it was worried about low tax revenues. But Russian officials say revenue collection has already improved sharply.
An IMF delegation which has been looking at Russia's latest economic figures and working out a programme for 1997 is due to leave Moscow this week.
If the IMF are satisfied that the economy is on track officials could recommend handing over one or more tranches of the loan.
